recentItems.title: FULL: SC explains 'unconstitutionality' of 2024, 2025 budget, 2026 special provisions | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
The Supreme Court on Tuesday (October 20) declared the unconstitutionality of the 2024 and 2025 General Appropriations Act and several special provisions of the 2026 national budget due to increases in the president’s total recommended appropriations through prohibited lump sums.

SC spokesperson Camille Ting explained the ruling on Wednesday (October 21) and clarified that the possible liability or accountability of the President and the House of Representatives are not the issue.
